limits: Real QA bill creation, a cash bookkeeping payment/update and deletion of only a newly created unpaid/unused bill are exercised. Fresh audit entries verify actor, module, timestamp and operation; update correlation uses an isolated writer window because the exposed DTO has no entity ID.

The Products filter sends the expected module query, excludes other modules and resets to the existing stream. Its response is empty in this company, so positive Products-event coverage is not claimed. The module choices omit actual Purchasing entries shown in the stream.
A real product CSV downloads successfully but produces no export audit event during fresh reads. Phase 3 audit CSV/JSON export and before/after diff requirements are excluded.
Owned QA bills/payments used for create/update remain as bookkeeping evidence. No real supplier funds are moved; no existing financial record is deleted.
automation: Corrected update navigation: after capturing the baseline audit stream, return to Bills before paying the owned QA bill.
Corrected the raw paginator contract (total is a direct field) and stopped requiring a fresh request when resetting a React Query filter to cached unfiltered data.

Investigated repeated Chromium asset-loading timeouts. Fingerprinted same-origin JS/CSS are fetched over HTTP and cached as unchanged bytes per worker; source hashes/byte counts are recorded. Live documents and all API reads/writes are preserved. A read-only diagnostic reached the QA page in 4.4 seconds, and affected cases were rerun.
Actor search is repeated after a fresh unfiltered read proving the displayed actor exists; zero search results are not inferred from a single stale request.

bugs.title: Audit user, action and date filtering controls are incomplete
steps: Sign in to Nexstock QA Company and open Audit Logs.
Confirm the activity stream includes named actors and Purchasing records.
Inspect the User and Module selectors, then click Filters.
Select Custom Range in Date Range and look for start/end date inputs.
bugs.expected: Users can filter the audit stream by an existing actor, recorded module, action type and a chosen date range.
bugs.actual: User offers All Users only. There is no Action Type selector; Filters opens no additional controls. Custom Range displays no from/to inputs or date-range query. Module choices omit the Purchasing records visible in the stream.
bugs.comment: Populate actual actors/modules and add action and date controls wired to the query. The existing Products query/reset is exercised separately; an empty Products result is not itself a defect.

bugs.title: Product CSV exports are absent from the audit activity stream
steps: Open Audit Logs and note the latest entry identifiers.
Open Products and download the actual standard CSV export.
Return to Audit Logs and inspect fresh activity repeatedly for at least 20 seconds.
Look for a new export event for the operation.
bugs.expected: The completed product export creates an audit event with its actor, timestamp and export operation.
bugs.actual: The real CSV file downloads, but no new export activity entry appears in fresh audit reads during the observation window.
bugs.comment: Record the export operation in the audit stream, including actor, time and useful scope/reference. This ticket concerns logging product exports, not the Phase 3 audit-export capability.

bugs.title: Searching an actor shown in Audit Logs returns no matching entries
steps: Open Audit Logs in Nexstock QA Company.
Find an entry whose User is Fuad Peerbocus.
Enter Fuad Peerbocus into Search by user, action, or details.
Clear/reload the unfiltered page, confirm that actor still has entries, and repeat the exact search.
bugs.expected: Searching the displayed actor name returns that actor's matching activity entries.
bugs.actual: The exact displayed actor returns zero entries on two fresh attempts, while fresh unfiltered activity still contains that actor.
bugs.comment: Include the displayed actor identity in backend search matching, with correct user joins/name handling. Keep tenant scoping and pagination intact. This is separate from the absent dedicated actor filter.
